data.one_liner: Provides confetti particle animations for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Shows physics‑based confetti (or snowflake) effects that can be launched anywhere in the widget tree. Offers options for particle count, spread, duration, fade‑out and snowfall behavior.
use_when: Quick visual effects without building custom particle systems
Cross‑platform apps needing a simple confetti overlay
avoid_when: Need for highly custom particle shapes or complex animation timelines
Performance‑critical screens with many simultaneous effects
When a full‑featured animation framework is already in use
strengths: Very easy to integrate with a single launch call
Physics‑based motion works consistently on all platforms
Built‑in snowfall support and configurable options
weaknesses: No theming or style system for particles
May add overhead if many launches are triggered rapidly

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: A general‑purpose animation library that can create custom particle effects if more flexibility is required
